build_heatmap_head: build a HeatmapHead instance with custom deconv channels and kernel sizes for pose estimation
create_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional layers with specified output channels and kernel sizes using _make_deconv_layers
create_conv_layers: create intermediate convolutional layers with SiLU activation using _make_conv_layers method
forward_heatmap_head: run forward pass on multi-scale feature maps to generate keypoint heatmaps
predict_keypoints: predict keypoint coordinates and scores from features with optional flip test TTA
